tooltipSaveDesc: IMPORTANT! Make sure to export your save file often to protect against losing your save. Saving when the exclamation mark appears also reward you with Omega Gold / Omega Items!
tooltipVoidexDesc: Browse your collection — caught Pokémon, defeated rivals, Glitch and Smitty forms, duelmons, fusions, and more!
tooltipEggGachaDesc: Redeem egg vouchers to hatch Pokémon with better IVs. Hatched Pokémon join your starters and can be added to your current party.
tooltipRunInfoDesc: During a run, view your current team, items, and stats. On the title screen, open your Run History of past runs.
tooltipPermaBarDesc: Show or hide your Omega Items bar. Purchased from the SHOP.
tooltipPlayerBarDesc: Show or hide your run items bar during battle. Displays items collected this run.
tooltipFoeBarDesc: Show or hide the enemy item bar during battle. See what items your opponent is using.
tooltipMoneyDesc: Money gained during your run, used to purchase items and pokemon!
tooltipPermaMoneyDesc: Your Omega currency. Spend it on Omega Items, fusion costs, and Omega loot rerolls. Earn it from bounties, rewards, saving, and Smitom.
tooltipSmitomDesc: Talk to Smitom for tips and lore about PokéVoid. Interact when the exclamation mark appears to earn Omega Gold / Omega Item rewards.
tooltipCatchDesc: Spend money to "buy" a trainer's Pokémon! Cost varies by wave and Omega Items.
tooltipMapDesc: View your current path within the Chaos! May it help you find your way through the darkness...
tooltipReplayDesc: Share your battle or watch another's replay. Click or Press Q.
